meta.name: azure-cost
meta.description: Azure cost management: query costs, forecast spending, optimize to reduce waste. WHEN: "Azure costs", "Azure bill", "cost breakdown", "how much am I spending", "forecast spending", "optimize costs", "reduce spending", "orphaned resources", "rightsize VMs", "cost spike", "reduce storage costs", "AKS cost". DO NOT USE FOR: deploying resources, provisioning, diagnostics, or security audits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询并优化 Azure 云支出，降低浪费
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常为 Azure 账单过高而烦恼
copy.tagline_en: Query and optimize Azure cloud spend, reduce waste
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about high Azure bills

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查询 Azure 历史成本、预测未来支出、给出减少浪费的优化建议;不处理资源部署、诊断或安全审计。
howto.when: 当你提到“Azure costs”“Azure bill”等成本相关词,或问花了多少钱、要预测/优化成本时触发。

say.text: 我这个月的 Azure 账单是多少?
say.note: 会按订阅或资源组查询历史成本。

say.text: 帮我预测下季度 Azure 支出。
say.note: 使用预测 API 估算未来开销。

say.text: 找出可以节省成本的 Azure 资源。
say.note: 触发成本优化流程,比如闲置资源或 VM 规格调整。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can query Azure historical costs, forecast future spending, and suggest ways to reduce waste. It does not handle deployment, diagnostics, or security audits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention cost-related terms like "Azure costs" or "Azure bill", ask about spending, or request cost forecasting or optimization.

say_en.text: What is my Azure bill for this month?
say_en.note: Queries historical costs by subscription or resource group.

say_en.text: Forecast my Azure spending for next quarter.
say_en.note: Uses the forecast API to estimate future expenses.

say_en.text: Find Azure resources where I can save money.
say_en.note: Runs the cost optimization workflow, e.g., idle resources or VM resizing.
